title: AI Workflow Automation in Mumbai
description: Automate repetitive operations with a Mumbai-based AI development team. Connect your tools, keep human approvals and scope one useful workflow with AlphaCodeAI.
headline: Less chasing. More doing.
lede: Your team should not be the glue between five different tools. We build AI workflows that move information, prepare the next step and leave important decisions with your people.
offer: Start with the task everyone is tired of repeating.
offerBody: Show us where work gets stuck. We’ll discuss whether rules, AI or a simpler process is the right fit, then outline a focused first build. No giant transformation project required.
audience: For operations teams, service businesses and growing companies

problemTitle: The work between the work adds up.
problemBody: Copying a lead into a CRM. Chasing a missing field. Turning an email into a task. These small handoffs interrupt people all day. A useful automation starts with a repeatable bottleneck, not a list of fashionable AI tools.

uses.title: Lead intake → owned next step
uses.body: Extract the request, flag missing details, create a CRM record and route it to the right person. Let a person approve the reply before it goes out.

uses.title: Inbox → organised operations
uses.body: Classify enquiries, prepare draft responses and escalate exceptions. Keep an activity trail so the team can see what happened and why.

uses.title: Scattered updates → a usable brief
uses.body: Bring authorised project updates into a structured summary. Identify blockers and prepare follow-up tasks without giving an agent unlimited access.

scopeTitle: One connected workflow. Built to be operated.
scope: A current-state workflow map and agreed success measures
Connections to selected tools after access and API checks
Rules, AI steps and explicit approval boundaries
Exception handling, activity logs and a manual fallback
A pilot with representative cases and team handover
fit: Best when the process repeats, the inputs are available and somebody owns the outcome.
notFit: If the process changes every day or has no clear rules, we should simplify it before automating it.
cost: Scope depends on the number of systems, API access, exception paths and data sensitivity. Start with one workflow; expand only after the pilot shows useful results.

proof.title: Turning a complex offer workflow into guided software.
proof.body: Configuration, pricing logic, revisions and offer preparation—one connected business problem. See how our Shapotools work brings structure to a process that previously lived inside a complex workbook.

steps.title: Find the bottleneck
steps.body: Walk through a real example and agree what a better outcome means.

steps.title: Build a bounded pilot
steps.body: Connect the minimum systems, test exceptions and define who approves what.

steps.title: Measure and improve
steps.body: Review handling time, manual corrections and reliability before extending the workflow.

faqs.question: Can you work with our current CRM, spreadsheets and email?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. We first check the tools, available APIs, permissions and export options. If a system cannot be integrated reliably, we explain the limitation and agree a safer handoff rather than promising an invisible workaround.

faqs.question: Do we need AI for every step?
faqs.answer: No. Rules are usually better for predictable decisions. We use AI where inputs are unstructured, such as messages or documents, and combine it with validation and human review.

faqs.question: How much does workflow automation cost?
faqs.answer: There is no useful flat quote without knowing the workflow. Integration count, permissions, exceptions, volume and monitoring drive cost. Tell us one process and the tools involved so we can discuss a scoped estimate, including recurring platform costs.

faqs.question: Can we start with a Mumbai-based team and work remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. AlphaCodeAI is based in Mumbai and works with teams remotely. We agree communication, access and review checkpoints around your operating needs.

title: WhatsApp Chatbot Development in India
description: Build a WhatsApp business chatbot for enquiries, qualification and human handoff. AlphaCodeAI helps Indian businesses scope a practical, policy-aware integration.
headline: Turn “Hi” into a real conversation.
lede: Answer the questions that keep coming in. Collect the details your team needs. Hand over with context. A business-specific WhatsApp assistant should make it easier to talk to you—not trap people in a bot.
offer: Bring your five most common customer questions.
offerBody: We’ll use them to discuss a useful conversation flow, where a person should step in and what needs to connect behind the scenes. You can start the conversation directly on WhatsApp.
audience: For businesses with recurring customer enquiries

flow.title: Can you help with this?
flow.detail: A customer starts a conversation with your business

flow.label: ASSISTANT
flow.title: A useful answer, not a menu maze
flow.detail: Grounded in your approved products and service information

flow.detail: Need, location and preferred next step

flow.label: HUMAN HANDOFF

problemTitle: The same questions. The same busy inbox.
problemBody: When every enquiry starts from scratch, your team spends time asking for details instead of helping. We design customer-service and sales-assistance workflows around your business, with a clear route to a human whenever the assistant should stop.

uses.title: Answer approved FAQs
uses.body: Explain your services, opening hours or process from maintained information. When the answer is missing, acknowledge the gap and route the question to your team.

uses.title: Qualify without interrogation
uses.body: Ask a few relevant questions, collect consented contact details and create a structured enquiry in your CRM or shared workflow.

uses.title: Make handoff feel human
uses.body: Let a customer ask for a person. Share the conversation summary, stop automated replies when appropriate and make ownership of the next step clear.

scopeTitle: The conversation is only half the build.

WhatsApp Business Platform integration after eligibility checks
Approved knowledge, fallback answers and configurable tone
Selected CRM or enquiry-system connection
Testing, human handoff and an operational guide
fit: Best for an established business with repeat enquiries and a team ready to handle qualified conversations.
notFit: Not for unsolicited bulk messaging, scraped contact lists or a general-purpose AI assistant distributed through WhatsApp.
cost: Development, hosting, model usage and Meta or provider messaging charges are separate cost drivers. Account eligibility, template approvals and third-party review can affect launch timing.

proof.title: Helping a property enquiry find its next step.
proof.body: Related work: Proofit’s website guides visitors through property-inspection services and structured enquiry capture. Explore the service-discovery thinking we bring to customer conversations, including a future WhatsApp workflow.

steps.body: Select the questions to handle, information to collect and moments to escalate.

faqs.question: Is this built on the official WhatsApp Business Platform?
faqs.answer: That is the intended integration route. We review your account, provider options and business eligibility before committing to implementation. We do not use unofficial personal-account automation.

faqs.question: Can the chatbot send follow-ups?
faqs.answer: Only within the applicable WhatsApp rules, consent requirements and messaging permissions. Approved templates may be required. We scope opt-out handling and avoid unsolicited bulk outreach; platform policies and charges are checked during setup.

faqs.question: Will customers still be able to talk to a person?
faqs.answer: Yes. Human handoff is a core part of the proposed workflow. The exact routing and inbox depend on your team’s tools, working hours and support process.

faqs.question: Can it support Hindi or other languages?
faqs.answer: We can scope multilingual conversations around the languages your customers use. Each supported language needs approved content and representative testing; we do not assume translation quality without checking it.

faqs.question: What do you need to estimate the project?
faqs.answer: Your business use case, common questions, current WhatsApp setup, expected conversation volume and the systems you want to connect. Share a short summary, without customer data, to begin.

briefLabel: What should the assistant help customers do?
briefPlaceholder: Example: Answer service questions, ask the customer’s location and pass the enquiry to our sales team.

headline: Build the part people will pay for.
lede: You do not need every feature in the pitch deck. You need one useful product experience that real users can try. We help founders turn an AI idea into a focused MVP with clear boundaries, feedback and a path forward.
offer: Bring the idea. We’ll help find the first useful version.
offerBody: Tell us who it is for, what they struggle with and what you want to learn. We’ll discuss the core user journey, the riskiest assumption and what belongs outside the first release.
audience: For founders and product teams testing a new AI product

problemTitle: A convincing demo is not yet a product.
problemBody: A prototype can look great while hiding slow responses, unreliable outputs and unclear user value. An MVP needs enough product thinking and engineering to test the business idea honestly—without building a whole company’s roadmap at once.

uses.title: An AI-first SaaS workflow
uses.body: Give users a clear way to provide input, review a generated result and put it to work. Scope accounts, permissions and billing only when the pilot needs them.

uses.title: A knowledge product
uses.body: Help a defined audience find answers in authorised information, with source references and a useful response when the evidence is insufficient.

uses.title: An assistant inside your product
uses.body: Add one bounded AI capability to an existing experience. Define what the assistant can do, what it cannot do and how users correct it.

scopeTitle: A product you can put in front of people.

A designed core journey and responsive interface
AI integration, data handling and evaluation examples
The application infrastructure agreed for your pilot
Deployment, handover and a prioritised next-step backlog
fit: Best when you can name the first users, the problem and the question your MVP needs to answer.
notFit: If the idea still needs customer discovery, we should narrow the problem before promising a full product build.
cost: The core journey, data readiness, integrations and security requirements determine cost and timeline. A prototype, a pilot and a production rollout are different scopes; we make that distinction in the proposal.

proof.title: A focused journey from question to action.
proof.body: Proofit brings product structure, service discovery and a guided enquiry experience together. See how a clearly defined user journey shapes the interface and the next action—exactly the kind of focus a first release needs.

steps.title: Cut to the core
steps.body: Identify one user journey, agree acceptance criteria and put the rest in a later list.

steps.title: Build and evaluate
steps.body: Deliver the experience in reviewable stages and test AI output against realistic examples.

steps.title: Release to learn
steps.body: Put the pilot in front of users, collect feedback and make an informed next-build decision.

faqs.question: Can you help if I only have an idea?
faqs.answer: Yes, but an idea alone is not a development specification. Start by telling us the user, their current workaround and the result you want to improve. We can then discuss discovery and a realistic first-build scope.

faqs.question: How long does an AI MVP take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the user journey, data, integrations and required quality. We estimate after defining the core scope and dependencies. We do not promise an arbitrary launch date before understanding those constraints.

faqs.question: Will I own the code?
faqs.answer: Ownership, repository access, third-party licences and handover are agreed in the project contract. Bring any requirements you have before we scope the build so there are no surprises.

faqs.question: What happens if AI is not reliable enough for the task?
faqs.answer: We test the riskiest behaviour early. Depending on the results, we can narrow the task, use rules, add human review or recommend not taking that approach further. A useful pilot should expose limitations, not hide them.

faqs.question: Can you improve an existing prototype?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share a non-sensitive description of the current product, what works and where it breaks. We can discuss a technical review and whether to improve the existing foundation or replace specific parts.

briefLabel: Who is the product for, and what will it help them do?
briefPlaceholder: Example: An assistant that helps small agencies turn approved meeting notes into project briefs.

title: AI Document Processing Services
description: Turn invoices, forms and PDFs into validated structured data. AlphaCodeAI builds document-processing workflows with review queues and business-system integrations.
headline: Your documents. Ready for the next step.
lede: Stop retyping the information your business already has. We build document workflows that extract useful fields, check them against your rules and put uncertain results in front of a person.
offer: Start with one document type and a clear destination.
offerBody: Tell us what comes in, which fields matter and where they need to go. We’ll discuss sample quality, validation and a pilot that can be measured against your current process.
audience: For operations teams handling repeat document-heavy work

flow.label: 01 / RECEIVE
flow.title: Invoice / form / PDF
flow.detail: An authorised upload or connected source

flow.label: 02 / EXTRACT
flow.title: Fields with a source
flow.detail: Capture the required data and preserve document references

flow.label: 03 / VALIDATE
flow.title: Check before trusting
flow.detail: Required fields, totals, duplicates and review rules

flow.label: 04 / DELIVER
flow.title: Structured, reviewed output
flow.detail: Approved data moves to a spreadsheet, queue or business system

problemTitle: Extraction alone does not finish the job.
problemBody: A number in a JSON file is not useful if it is the wrong number. Good document automation includes source traceability, business checks and a place to resolve exceptions—especially when layouts, scan quality and missing information vary.

uses.title: Invoices and purchase records
uses.body: Capture agreed fields and line items, check required values and flag mismatches. Keep approvals and payment decisions with your existing financial controls.

uses.title: Forms and onboarding packs
uses.body: Organise submitted information, check completeness and identify records that need clarification. Restrict access to personal information according to the agreed workflow.

uses.title: Operational PDFs and reports
uses.body: Turn repeat document types into structured records that your team can search, review and export. Evaluate unusual layouts separately rather than assuming all PDFs behave alike.

scopeTitle: From sample set to a reviewable workflow.
scope: An agreed document set, field schema and acceptance criteria
Extraction suited to your layouts and scan quality
Validation rules, duplicate checks and source references
An exception queue with a human correction path
Approved exports or integration with your chosen system
fit: Best for repeated document types with a clear schema and people available to review exceptions.
notFit: A poor fit for a promise of perfect extraction from every scan. Handwriting, mixed layouts and low-quality images need separate evaluation.
cost: Document volume, page count, layout variation, fields, review needs and integrations drive the estimate. We distinguish one-time implementation from recurring processing and hosting costs.

proof.title: Structured logic behind a better offer process.
proof.body: Related workflow work: Shapotools turns workbook-based configuration and pricing into a guided offer process. It demonstrates our approach to business rules and structured outputs. Document extraction is evaluated separately against your own sample set.

steps.title: Define the dataset
steps.body: Agree representative, appropriately redacted samples and the fields that matter.

steps.title: Test the hard cases
steps.body: Evaluate missing values, unclear scans and layout variations before choosing the workflow.

steps.title: Pilot with reviewers
steps.body: Measure field-level quality, correction time and exception rates before increasing volume.

faqs.question: What accuracy can you guarantee?
faqs.answer: No single accuracy figure is meaningful before testing your documents. We agree field-level acceptance criteria on a representative sample, report exceptions and keep human review where the consequences of an error matter.

faqs.question: Can this process scanned PDFs and images?
faqs.answer: We can evaluate them. OCR quality depends on resolution, layout, language and legibility. Handwritten fields or damaged scans may require a different approach or manual review.

faqs.question: Do I need to upload confidential documents to enquire?
faqs.answer: No. Describe the document type, volume and required fields. Do not send confidential records through this enquiry form. Sample exchange, access controls and data-processing arrangements are agreed separately.

faqs.question: Can extracted data go into our ERP or CRM?
faqs.answer: Subject to available APIs and permissions, that can be part of the scope. A controlled export may be a better first step if the destination system has limited integration support.

faqs.question: How do we know whether automation is worthwhile?
faqs.answer: Compare the existing handling time and error correction effort with pilot results, including review time and recurring costs. We recommend starting with a repeated document type that has enough volume to make the comparison useful.

briefLabel: Which documents and fields are slowing your team down?
briefPlaceholder: Example: Supplier invoices arrive as PDFs. We need the invoice number, totals and line items in our system.

title: AI Chatbot for Real Estate Lead Qualification
description: Qualify property enquiries, answer approved project questions and route site-visit requests. AlphaCodeAI builds real estate AI chatbots for Indian sales teams.
keywords: AI chatbot for real estate India
eyebrow: AI chatbots for real estate · India
headline: A better enquiry. A warmer handoff.
lede: A property enquiry should not disappear into an inbox. Help buyers get approved project information, share their requirements and request a site visit—then give your sales team the context to follow up properly.
offer: Start with one project and one lead journey.
offerBody: Show us how an enquiry reaches your team today. We’ll discuss the questions to answer, the details to qualify and the handoff that makes the next conversation easier.
audience: For developers, brokerages and property-service teams
flowTitle: From interest to a useful handoff

flow.title: I’m looking for a home
flow.detail: A visitor asks about a project or available options

flow.label: QUALIFICATION

problemTitle: Your sales team should not start from zero.
problemBody: A name and phone number do not explain what a buyer needs. A focused property assistant can gather relevant context, answer from your approved material and route the enquiry. Your team still owns pricing, availability and the relationship.

uses.title: Project questions, answered carefully
uses.body: Explain approved amenities, location and project details. Connect a maintained source for changing information; never invent availability, discounts or commitments.

uses.title: Buyer needs, captured clearly
uses.body: Ask about budget range, preferred area, configuration and timing. Collect only the details needed for the enquiry, with a clear handoff to the right sales owner.

uses.title: Site-visit requests, organised
uses.body: Capture a preferred slot and route it to your team or scheduling system. Call it a request until the actual appointment has been confirmed.

scope: A project-specific knowledge and qualification flow
Website assistant, with WhatsApp scoped if appropriate
Lead routing to an agreed CRM or shared enquiry workflow
Human escalation and site-visit request handling
Testing for stale information, unknown answers and duplicate leads
fit: Best for a team with incoming enquiries, maintained project information and a clear follow-up process.
notFit: A chatbot does not create buyer demand on its own. It cannot guarantee bookings, replace your sales team or make unsupported property claims.
cost: The number of projects, channels, languages, CRM connections and scheduling requirements affects scope. A single-project pilot is usually easier to evaluate than a portfolio-wide rollout.

proof.title: A clearer route from property concern to enquiry.
proof.body: Property-sector work: Proofit helps visitors understand inspection services and take a clear next step. Explore our approach to guided discovery and structured enquiries, then let’s discuss how your buyer journey differs.

steps.title: Map the buyer questions
steps.body: Select one project, approve the source information and agree qualification fields.

steps.title: Connect the handoff
steps.body: Define lead ownership, CRM mapping and how a site-visit request becomes confirmed.

steps.title: Review the lead quality
steps.body: Pilot the flow and inspect completeness, routing failures and the team’s follow-up experience.

faqs.question: Will this generate new real estate leads?
faqs.answer: It is designed to help handle and qualify enquiries from traffic you already attract. Search, campaigns and referrals bring visitors; the assistant improves the path to a useful conversation. Lead volume and sales are not guaranteed.

faqs.question: Can it show current pricing and availability?
faqs.answer: Only from an approved, maintained source with clear update rules. If live information is unavailable or uncertain, the assistant should direct the buyer to your team rather than invent an answer.

faqs.question: Can it connect to our real estate CRM?
faqs.answer: We assess your CRM’s API, permissions and required fields. Lead creation, assignment and duplicate handling can be included when the integration supports them.

faqs.question: Does it work on WhatsApp as well as the website?
faqs.answer: Both can be scoped. A website assistant and a WhatsApp Business Platform integration have different setup, policy and operating requirements, which we review before estimating.

faqs.question: Can it book site visits automatically?
faqs.answer: It can collect visit requests. Confirmed booking requires a reliable scheduling source and agreed business rules. Without those, the flow clearly tells the buyer that the team will confirm the request.
